audio.source: Same existing three CC0 real firework field recordings; extra recorded upper-band crackle and quiet reflections, no new synthesized noise or piano.
audio.attacks: First 180 ms of accepted recorded burst attacks retained within one PCM quantization step; checked per burst.
audio.overlap: Normal outgoing cues no longer preempt existing tails at the third overlapping voice. Each recording runs its natural finite fade; maximum twelve temporary voices, no replay queue.
audio.reverse: Old outgoing tails crossfade over 650 ms when reversing direction. Mute/hidden remain immediate intentional-silence controls.
audio.preview: Before/after 10.2-second edited-sample mixes, identical event timing/master level, no independent normalization. Not a microphone recording.

visual.size_order: large / small / larger / small / largest, preserved
visual.behavior: After the spread, more individually phased glitter falls with short fine trails; late particles have varied twinkle rates, linger times and decay. Final crown remains luminous longer; falling particles are bounded around the word/period.
visual.reverse: Same fixed particle identities and scroll-progress mapping retrace their trajectories upward and into the full stop; no rerandomization or wall-clock drift.
visual.idle: Visual pause holds the frame; existing skip-identical-frame and boundary early exits remain. No new perpetual frame loop.

limitations.note: Browser automation and native touch emulation verify behavior and signals, not physical iPhone listening comfort or guaranteed smoothness.
